user_stories.title: US-001 · Borrow a Book
business_value: Members can take a book home without queuing at the desk, so the desk staff spend their time on enquiries instead of checkouts.

acceptance_criteria.description: A member who borrows an available book from the catalogue sees the loan on the My Loans page with its due date.
A member who already holds the maximum number of loans cannot borrow another book and is told why.
preconditions: The loan limit for the member's category is set.

acceptance_criteria.description: A member can renew a loan once from the My Loans page, which moves its due date out by one loan period.
A printable loan slip is offered after a book is borrowed.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: The due date is now shown on My Loans and sent by email, so the slip is no longer needed.

acceptance_criteria.description: A member is reminded by email two days before a loan is due.
A member can borrow an e-book from the catalogue.
not_in_scope: Reading the e-book inside the web app.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Backlog - no target version; the e-book licensing terms are not agreed yet.

preconditions: The member is signed in with an account in good standing.
not_in_scope: Borrowing from a partner library through inter-library loan.

user_stories.title: US-002 · Join the Library
notes: The sign-up wizard is also used by desk staff on the desk terminal.
business_value:
New members can join online at any hour, so sign-ups no longer depend on desk opening times.
  - Most sign-up requests used to arrive by email outside opening hours.
Desk staff stop re-typing paper forms.

acceptance_criteria.description: An applicant who completes the sign-up wizard sees a membership number on the confirmation step.
The applicant receives a confirmation email with the membership number.
The applicant can choose the card type that matches their age.

user_stories.title: US-003 · Register at the Desk
business_value: Residents without internet access can still become members.

acceptance_criteria.description: Desk staff can register a resident from a paper form and hand over a printed membership card.

user_stories.deprecation_reason: Desk staff now register members through the online sign-up wizard, so the separate desk registration flow is retired.

features.title: FEAT-001 · Catalogue Search Page
features.purpose: The screen where a member searches the library catalogue, narrows the results and borrows an available book.
notes: Results are paged 20 at a time; filters and sorting apply to every page.

pages.purpose: The screen where a member searches the library catalogue, narrows the results and borrows an available book.

features.title: FEAT-004 · Loan Detail Page
features.purpose: The screen where a member sees one loan in full.
features.stub_reason: The loan detail template carries no test-id attributes yet; surface documented from the design. discovered 2026-09-28

pages.purpose: The screen where a member sees one loan in full.

features.title: FEAT-005 · Printable Loan Slip
features.purpose: A printable page with the title, member number and due date of a new loan.
features.deprecation_reason: Due dates are shown on My Loans and sent by email, so members no longer print slips.

pages.purpose: A printable page with the title, member number and due date of a new loan.

features.title: FEAT-003 · Membership Sign-up Wizard
features.purpose: Multi-step wizard where a resident joins the library and receives a membership number.

pages.purpose: Multi-step wizard where a resident joins the library and receives a membership number.
Step 3 (Confirm) — the applicant reviews the details and joins.
Step 1 (Details) — the applicant's name, date of birth and home address.
notes: The address field suggests matches as the applicant types.

features.title: FEAT-002 · My Loans Page
features.purpose: The screen where a member sees the books they have on loan, with due dates, and renews a loan.

pages.purpose: The screen where a member sees the books they have on loan, with due dates, and renews a loan.

functionalities.title: FUNC-001 · Catalogue Search Page - Filter Search Results

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting a filter value keeps only the results that match it.
Clearing all filters restores the full result list.

preconditions: A search has returned results from more than one author and subject.
functionalities.rationale: Filtering narrows the results already shown; it never runs a new search, so it stays a separate behaviour from the search box.

functionalities.title: FUNC-002 · Catalogue Search Page - Sort by Popularity
notes: The popularity score is refreshed overnight from the previous day's loans.

acceptance_criteria.description: Choosing "Most popular" orders the results by the number of loans in the last 90 days, highest first.

functionalities.deprecation_reason: Popularity favoured a handful of titles; members asked for relevance and newest-first instead.

functionalities.title: FUNC-003 · My Loans Page - Renew Loan

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing "Renew" moves the loan's due date out by one loan period.
The "Renew" button is disabled once the loan has been renewed.

not_in_scope: Renewing a loan that another member has reserved.

functionalities.title: FUNC-004 · My Loans Page - Show Overdue Badge

acceptance_criteria.description: An "Overdue" badge is shown on a loan whose due date has passed.
The badge shows the late fee accrued so far.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Backlog - no target version; the fee schedule is still under review by the library board.

functionalities.title: FUNC-005 · Membership Sign-up Wizard - Validate Required Details

acceptance_criteria.description: Leaving a required detail empty shows an inline error under it and keeps the applicant on the details step.
A date of birth in the future is rejected with an inline error.
Filling in the {required-detail} clears the inline error under it.

functionalities.title: FUNC-006 · Membership Sign-up Wizard - Submit Application

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing "Join" creates the membership and shows its number on the confirmation step.
Pressing "Join" a second time does not create a second membership.

preconditions: The applicant has completed the details and card type steps.

functionalities.title: FUNC-007 · Printable Loan Slip - Print Slip

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing "Print" opens the browser print dialog with the slip's title, member number and due date.

functionalities.deprecation_reason: The due date is shown on My Loans and sent by email, so the printed slip is no longer needed.

functionalities.title: FUNC-008 · Catalogue Search Page - Sort Results

acceptance_criteria.description: Results are ordered by relevance by default.
Choosing "Newest first" orders the results by publication date, newest first.
The {sort-order} applies to every page of results, not only the first.

not_in_scope: Sorting by popularity, which was retired.
Saving a sort order between visits.

functionalities.title: FUNC-009 · My Loans Page - Loan List States

acceptance_criteria.description: A member with loans sees one row per loan with its title and due date.
A member with no loans sees "You have no books on loan" and a link to the catalogue.

functionalities.title: FUNC-010 · My Loans Page - Total Fines Owed

acceptance_criteria.description: The total shown is the sum of the fines on every loan, to the cent.
A fine that is {fine-state} is left out of the total.

functionalities.rationale: The total is shown on its own, not on payment, so members see what they owe before they come to the desk.

functionalities.title: FUNC-011 · Membership Sign-up Wizard - Redirect Existing Members

acceptance_criteria.description: A signed-in member who opens the sign-up wizard is taken to the My Loans page instead.

functionalities.title: FUNC-012 · Loan Detail Page - Show Renewal History

acceptance_criteria.description: A loan that has been renewed shows the date of each renewal.
